create_grid1d: create a 1-D grid of cells with faces from sorted face centers or cell count
build_time_varying_array: build a time-interpolated array from primitives, arrays, or xarray DataArray inputs
create_sparse_time_varying_array: create a sparse time-varying array with zero-valued profiles except at specified locations
run_get_value: run time and rho interpolation to get array values on cell, face, or face_right grids
set_grid_on_model: set a Grid1D on a model and all its TimeVaryingArray submodels with strict, force, or relaxed mode
